title: Differential compatibility of currying
statement: For every cochain complexes K,L,M of sheaf modules over R and integers n,m, the chosen degreewise currying morphisms satisfy homTensorDegreewiseMap K L M n followed by the differential from n to m on the total-tensor Hom complex equals the differential from n to m on the iterated Hom complex followed by homTensorDegreewiseMap K L M m.

proof.text: For m=n+1, apply joint monicity of the product projections specified by homComplex_projections_exists. Expand the target Hom differential at factor t using its defining formula. Distribute precomposition over subtraction and the integer-unit scalar, then apply the iterated-differential component calculation.
For m other than n+1, the two differentials vanish by HomologicalComplex.shape, and the composites are zero.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A90; target differential expansion and product joint monicity in Lean, component calculation split off
